intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Electric Current and Circuits — charge, current and voltage; resistance and its dependence on wire dimensions; Ohm's law and circuit diagrams; and series and parallel circuits. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`). BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so this is DC circuit analysis ($I = Q/t$, $V = IR$, series/parallel equivalent resistance, VIR charts) held to AP Physics 2 rigor; no electric power formula, EMF/internal resistance, or Kirchhoff's-law simultaneous equations.

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand (round numbers; parallel pairs chosen to give whole-number results). Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.

The bank is tranche 1; drawn-circuit-diagram items will follow.
